title: buglossum sempervirens
intro: Buglossum sempervirens, commonly known as Blue Bugloss, is a perennial plant species in the borage family. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, as well as its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Buglossum sempervirens include expectorant, antispasmodic, and diaphoretic properties, making it useful for treating coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
